title: Need Free AI Game Assets? Now you can generate Sprites and Tilesets for your Indie game in seconds
author: NoPromotion2534
selftext:
Let’s be honest: spending half a day on a single sprite that still looks shitty... that's the worst!

You deserve to spend your time on the fun part: coding. That’s why I created Spritefy. Consider it an early Christmas gift from me to you! :D

You can use it to generate all your game assets in seconds and keep your workflow moving.

Here is what you can create with it:

* Characters & Animations: Sprites in different positions and animation frames.
* World Building: Seamless tile sets and backgrounds that match your style.
* Items
* Effects

There is a free plan available, so you can jump right in and start creating without any catch.

It’s still in the early stages, so I’d love to hear your honest feedback. What’s missing? What should I add next?

Try it out here: [https://spritefy.com](https://spritefy.com)

Enjoy and Merry Christmas! 🎄
